originality.rationale: The claim is strictly confined to the complete multi-prime divisor lattice and its full tensor-multiplicity spectrum, determinant pencil, exact singularity and inertia. The prime-power local generalized spectrum in Merikoski et al. 2025 §4.2, classical totient determinant, and matrix divisibility are unambiguously prior work. Inspected primary full texts do not state the global product-lattice classification. A natural tensor consequence of the known local theorem could have circulated elsewhere, hence publication priority is not guaranteed.

value.rationale: The complete divisor set is the canonical factor-closed arithmetic index domain. Determining every generalized eigenvalue with multiplicity, the whole parameter-dependent characteristic determinant, and the exact positivity/negativity/nullity of G+L for every integer is a natural finite-dimensional classification, rather than a cherry-picked numerical slice. The odd number of prime factors with each exponent≥2 is the exact singularity boundary, and its nullity is the product of (a_i−1). The previously known local calculation alone does not state this global classification; no larger downstream theorem is required.
